headline: Issue #50 landed — live dispatch-status feed + board UX polish on /ops/tasks. lib/tasks/dispatch-status.mjs resolves each dispatched task's linked PR via a new GitHub port method (getLinkedPullRequest, reads the issue timeline's cross-referenced events — same mechanism as GitHub's 'Development' sidebar) and collapses onto the existing dispatch_status enum: dispatched → running (PR open) → done (merged, also flips task status + stamps completed_at) / failed (closed unmerged). TTL-cached + fail-soft (mirrors lib/projects/index.mjs's attachRepoStatuses pattern) so GET /api/tasks stays polite to GitHub's rate limit across the client's 8s poll. New migration 0009_task_pr_url.sql (pr_url column, NOT YET APPLIED — see next). Board UX: dispatch-status badge + PR link per row, a 'Recently completed' section independent of the status filter, Auto/Queue/Dispatch grouped+titled to disambiguate, confirm-on-Trash, inline action-result feedback (success/error, was silently swallowed before) + aria-live announcements, mobile stacking for the action row. New unit tests for the pure derivation + timeline-parsing functions. COULD NOT RUN pnpm typecheck/test/test:layout in this sandbox — pnpm itself is blocked by the tool-approval gate with no interactive approver; changes are syntax-reviewed by hand only, Adrian should run the AUTO-VALIDATE suite before merging. PREVIOUS: #44 auto-record preview_url on leads. Production LIVE.
